about_the_game:
Debut Title from Wuhan Liyu Games!
Experience the heartfelt long-distance romance visual novel PaperKite: Threads of Distant Love (Zhi Yuan)!

This trial version only supports Simplified Chinese (additional languages will be added in the future)

The total word count of the game is about 100000-150000 words, and the trial version is about 15000 words, which only includes the content of the previous chapters of the game

The trial version tells the story of Shen Luoying and the male lead in the early stages of the game, and lays the groundwork for their separation in a different place. The official version of the game will depict the story of the two after their separation (expected to be released by the end of summer 2025)

Amidst Cicadas' Summer Song, Acceptance Letters Tear Open the Cracks of Youth

Through faint screen glows, they weave longing across eight hundred kilometers. Their love resembles a paper kite lifted by monsoon winds—the spool threads binding youth's most fervent obsessions, yet exposed to tempests of timezone divides, new attractions, and gnawing doubts. When trust's fragile string nears breaking point, can they catch the fleeting trade winds? This coming-of-age journey spanning latitudes and longitudes: will it become scattered kite debris... or an eternal soaring vow?

After June's gaokao results, Shen Luoying and Chen Yanqing—newly confessed lovers—are torn between Beijing and Jiangcheng universities by parental expectations and academic scores. Separated yet determined, they nurture their fragile long-distance bond through four tumultuous college years. Like a paper kite vulnerable to the slightest storm, their romance demands mutual devotion to harness life's unpredictable winds. Can they transform pressures into updrafts? Will their love withstand the turbulence... or unravel mid-flight?

Gameplay

Immerse yourself in a visual novel experience where every click propels the story forward. Navigate branching paths through intuitive mouse interactions, with your decisions dynamically shaping 6+ unique endings.

As a text-based adventure game (AVG), this title blends:

A story-driven experience anchored by rich narrative choices

Core Interaction Loop:

Read/Advance: Click through dialogue and environmental descriptions

Decide: Make critical choices at narrative crossroads

Discover: Unlock multiple endings through replayable branching paths

Experience: Witness dynamic CGs and voice-acted scenes triggered by your actions

STAFF

  • Project by: Beijing Liyu Tech (LICOGAME)

  • Development: Wuhan Second Branch Studio (Liyu Games)

  • Artwork/Character Design: YuanGungun

  • Story Concept:CangLanDeFeng

  • Story Concept:BaTuola

  • Music: Naonao丶

  • Voice Acting: Yan Momo

CHARACTER PROFILE
Name: Shen Luoying
Height: 164 cm
CV: Yan Momo

GAME SPECS

  • Story Length: 50,000–80,000 words (approx.)

  • CGs: 8–20 scenes

  • Resolution: 4K (3840×2160)

  • Voices: Fully voiced except protagonist

  • Cast: Single heroine + protagonist

  • Genre: Multi-ending romance visual novel

  • Languages: Simplified Chinese | Traditional Chinese (pending) | Japanese (TBD) | English (TBD) | Russian (TBD)

GAMEPLAY
Dive into their journey through a classic visual novel experience. Click through narrative choices that shape the story’s direction, unlocking multiple endings based on your decisions.

Key Features:

  • A tender, slice-of-life portrayal of young love tested by distance

  • Stunning 4K artwork capturing emotional highs and lows

  • Branching narrative with impactful player-driven choices

  • Full voice acting for immersive storytelling (heroine only)
